FROM technicians AS t

ORDER BY

  t.technician_id
gold_sql:
WITH technician_bike_days AS (
  SELECT
    t.technician_id,
    t.technician_name,
    b.bike_id,
    julianday('2024-12-31') - julianday(b.acquired_on) + 1 AS bike_days_in_fleet
  FROM technicians AS t
  CROSS JOIN bikes AS b
),
maintenance_per_technician_bike AS (
  SELECT
    m.technician_id,
    m.bike_id,
    COUNT(*) AS maintenance_jobs
  FROM maintenance AS m
  GROUP BY
    m.technician_id,
    m.bike_id
)
SELECT
  tbd.technician_id AS technician_id,
  tbd.technician_name AS technician_name,
  COUNT(*) AS bikes_considered,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mptb.maintenance_jobs, 0)) * 1.0 / SUM(tbd.bike_days_in_fleet), 6) AS maintenance_jobs_per_bike_day
FROM technician_bike_days AS tbd
LEFT JOIN maintenance_per_technician_bike AS mptb
  ON mptb.technician_id = tbd.technician_id
 AND mptb.bike_id = tbd.bike_id
GROUP BY
  tbd.technician_id,
  tbd.technician_name
ORDER BY
  maintenance_jobs_per_bike_day DESC,
  tbd.technician_id
